name: Viktor
text: Keywords: Augment. When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Hex Core Upgrade in hand. Level up: You've played 7+ created cards.

name: Mechanized Mimic
text: Keywords: Augment. Attack: Grant me all keywords on allies.

name: Give It All
text: Grow all allies' Power and Health to the highest Power or Health among allies. Grant all allies allied keywords.

name: Calculated Creations
text: Create an Armed Gearhead, Ballistic Bot, or Nyandroid in hand and grant it +1|+1.

name: Iterative Improvement
text: Pick a follower. Create a copy of it in hand with +1|+1.

name: Stress Testing
text: Remove Fleeting from all cards in hand. When I'm discarded, draw 1 Fleeting.

name: Hexcore Foundry
text: Keywords: Landmark. Round Start: ALL players draw 1.

name: Aftershock
text: Deal 3 to a unit or destroy a landmark.

name: Tri-beam Improbulator
text: Deal 1 to a unit. Summon a random 1 cost follower. While I'm in hand, increase both by 1 when you play a 3 cost card.

name: Poro Cannon
text: To play, discard 1. Create 2 Daring Poros in hand.

name: Stalking Shadows
text: Pick a follower from the top 4 cards in your deck. Draw it, place the rest into your deck, then create an exact Ephemeral copy in hand.

name: Evershade Stalker
text: Keywords: Ephemeral, Fearsome, Can't Block. Nightfall: Create a copy of me in hand.

name: Gluttony
text: Kill an ally with Last Breath to summon a follower from your deck that costs 1 more.

name: Passage Unearned
text: Obliterate all units that were summoned, but not played, this round.

name: Encroaching Shadows
text: Grant ALL allies in your deck and hand +2|+2 and Ephemeral.

name: Go Hard
text: Drain 1 from a unit. Create 2 copies of Go Hard in your deck. Every third time this happens, transform all copies of me everywhere into Pack Your Bags.

name: Shroud of Darkness
text: The next time you summon an ally this round, give it +1|+0 and SpellShield this round.

name: Nocturne
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Nightfall: Grant an enemy Vulnerable and give enemies -1|-0 this round. Level up: You've attacked with 5+ Nightfall or Fearsome allies.

name: Doombeast
text: Nightfall: Drain 2 from the enemy Nexus.

name: Pesky Specter
text: Keywords: Ephemeral, Last Breath. Last Breath: Create 2 copies of me in the enemy deck.

name: Stygian Onlooker
text: Nightfall: Give me +2|+0 and Fearsome this round.

name: Unspeakable Horror
text: Drain 1 from anything. Nightfall: Create a random Nightfall card in hand.

name: Duskrider
text: Keywords: Fearsome. Nightfall: Grant me +1|+0 for each time we've activated Nightfall this game.

name: Risen Mists
text: Summon a Mistwraith.

name: Flurry of Fists
text: Grant an ally +1|+0 and Quick Attack. If it already has it, grant it Double Attack instead.

name: Pix!
text: Keywords: Support, Barrier. Support: Give my supported ally +2|+1 this round.

name: Whimsy!
text: Transform a follower into a 1|1 Squirrel and Silence it this round.

name: Flower Child
text: When I'm supported, grant me +2|+0.

name: Singular Will
text: Pick an ally. Recall ALL other units and landmarks.

name: Lulu
text: Keywords: Support. Support: My supported ally grows up to 4|4 this round. Level up: Allies have been supported 3+ times.

name: Swole Squirrel
text: Strike: Double my Power.

name: Fae Guide
text: Play: Grant an ally Elusive.

name: Trevor Snoozebottom
text: Keywords: Support. Support: Create an attacking Mumblesprite with my supported ally's stats.

name: Young Witch
text: Keywords: Elusive, Support. Support: Give my supported ally Quick Attack and +1|+0 this round.

name: Nopeify!
text: Stop a Fast or Slow spell that costs 3 or less.

name: Go Get It
text: Recall an ally to summon an exact Ephemeral copy in its place. Reduce its cost to 0 this round.

name: Fuzzy Caretaker
text: Keywords: Support. When I'm supported, give me +0|+3 this round. Support: Give my supported ally +3|+0 this round.

name: Dragonguard Lieutenant
text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold a Dragon, grant me Challenger.

name: Confront
text: Grant an ally Challenger. If it's a Dragon, draw 1.

name: Stony Suppressor
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. ALL spells cost 1 more.

name: Molten Breath
text: An ally with Fury strikes the 2 weakest enemies one after another.

name: Strafing Strike
text: An ally and an enemy strike each other. Then, if the ally is a Dragon, heal it 5.

name: Shyvana
text: Keywords: Fury. Attack: Give me +1|+1 this round. Level up: Dragon allies have dealt 16+ damage.

name: Dragonguard Lookout
text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold a Dragon, Rally.

name: Egghead Researcher
text: When I'm summoned, create a random Dragon in hand.

name: Kadregrin the Infernal
text: Keywords: Fury. When I'm summoned, grant other Dragon allies everywhere +4|+4.

name: For The Fallen
text: When you summon an Elite, reduce my cost by 1. For each ally that died this round, summon a Dauntless Vanguard.

name: Sharpsight
text: Give an ally +1|+2 and Sharpsight this round.

name: The Scargrounds
text: Keywords: Landmark. When an ally survives damage, grant it +1|+0 and Tough.

name: Troll Scavenger
text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold an 8+ cost card, grant me +3|+0.

name: Revitalizing Roar
text: Pick a unit in hand to reveal. Heal your Nexus equal to its Power. Enlightened: Reduce its cost to 0.

name: Augur of the Old Ones
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Regeneration. Play: If you Behold an 8+ cost card, grant an ally Overwhelm and Regeneration.

name: Trundle
text: Keywords: Regeneration. When I'm summoned, create an Ice Pillar in hand. Level up: I've seen you play Ice Pillar.

name: Icequake
text: Give ALL units -3|-0 this round. Deal 3 to ALL units.

name: Troll Chant
text: Give an ally +0|+2 to give an enemy -2|-0 this round.

name: Troll Ravager
text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold an 8+ cost card, grant me Regeneration.

name: Call the Wild
text: For the top 4 cards in your deck, draw each Yeti, Poro, and Elnuk. Then place the rest into your deck.

name: Faces of the Old Ones
text: Round Start: If you Behold an 8+ cost card, get an extra mana gem this round.

name: Voices of the Old Ones
text: Get 2 empty mana gems. For the top 5 cards in your deck, draw each card that costs 8+. Then place the rest into your deck.

name: Troll Gifts
text: Grant an ally Regeneration. If they already have it, grant them +2|+2 instead.

name: Feel The Rush
text: Summon 2 different, random champions from your hand and deck. Grow their stats up to 10|10.

name: Ekko
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Strike: Create a Fleeting Time Trick in hand. Level up: You've Predicted 4+ times. When I level up, create 3 Chronobreaks in your deck.

name: Chirean Sumpworker
text: Keywords: Elusive. When you summon another Chirean Sumpworker, Obliterate me and transform allied Chirean Sumpworkers everywhere into Sumpworks Posses.

name: Production Surge
text: To play, spend all your mana. Summon random Turrets whose total cost equals the mana spent.

name: Timewinder
text: To play, discard 1. Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.

name: Called Shot
text: Draw 1. Create a Parallel Convergence in your deck.

name: Defective Swapbot
text: Play: Swap my stats with another unit.

name: Volunteer Elnuk
text: When I'm summoned, create a random Elnuk in the top 6 cards of your deck.

name: Concurrent Timelines
text: Grant followers in your hand "When you play me, pick 1 of 3 followers with my cost and transform me into that follower."

name: Boom Baboon
text: When I'm summoned, create a Flame Chompers! in hand.

name: Time Trick
text: Predict, then draw 1.

name: Practical Perfectionist
text: Play: Predict. Create 3 copies of the chosen card in your deck.

name: Glorious Evolution
text: Your cards have -1 cost, Augment, are created by Glorious Evolution, and are now Tech.

name: Bone Skewer
text: An ally strikes an enemy, then moves to the top of your deck.

name: Jaull-fish
text: Keywords: Lurk. Play: Each Lurker ally strikes a random enemy.

name: Redfin Hammersnout
text: Keywords: Lurk. Play: Grant an enemy Vulnerable.

name: Pyke
text: Keywords: Lurk, Quick Attack. When I Lurk, transform me into Death From Below. Level up: Allied Pykes have dealt 15+ damage.

name: Monster Harpoon
text: Keywords: Plunder. Plunder: I cost 2 less. Deal 5 to a unit.

name: Line 'Em Up
text: Summon a Powder Keg. Create a Knock 'Em Down in hand.

name: Loaded Dice
text: Next round, when you damage the enemy Nexus, Nab 1.

name: Snapjaw Swarm
text: Keywords: Lurk. Play: I start a free attack.

name: Ripper's Bay
text: Keywords: Lurk, Landmark. When allies attack, before activating Lurk, grant the top ally in your deck Lurk and it becomes a Lurker.

name: Lost Riches
text: Draw a Treasure. If there aren't any to draw, create 2 Treasures in your deck instead.

name: Reaver's Row
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. When I count down, summon a random 1 cost follower. Countdown 2: Grant 1 cost allies +2|+1 and Fearsome.

name: Bloodbait
text: Keywords: Lurk. Create a Snapjaw Swarm on top of your deck.

name: Ruined Rex
text: Play: Play Cannon Barrage on randomly targeted enemies for each card you've drawn this round, up to 6 times.

name: The List
text: Grant an enemy Vulnerable. If it's already Vulnerable, the strongest ally starts a free attack Challenging it.

name: Defiant Dance
text: Recall a unit. Blade Dance 1.

name: Irelia
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Attune. When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Flawless Duet in hand. Level up: You've attacked with 14+ allies.

name: Scattered Pod
text: Play: Draw a Slow, Fast, or Burst spell. Enlightened: I have Elusive.

name: Blossoming Blade
text: Play: Blade Dance 2.

name: Vanguard's Edge
text: Pick an ally to attack alongside the Blades, then Blade Dance 3.

name: Dancing Droplet
text: Keywords: Elusive. When I'm Recalled, draw 1.

name: Shadow Apprentice
text: Keywords: Elusive. When you summon an Ephemeral ally, give me +1|+0 this round.

name: Zinneia, Steel Crescendo
text: Keywords: Elusive. When you Blade Dance, I attack with the Blades. Play: Blade Dance 1.

name: Syncopation
text: Swap 2 allies.

name: Lead and Follow
text: Recall an ally to create a Flawless Duet in hand.

name: Sacred Protector
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. Play: Give an ally Barrier this round and draw a Shen. Allies with Barrier have Double Attack.

name: Shadows of the Past
text: Recall each ally and summon a Living Shadow in its place.

name: Field Musicians
text: Keywords: Attune. Each round, once you've summoned 3 other allies, refill your spell mana and draw 1.

name: Careful Preparation
text: To play, place a card from your hand into your deck. Predict, then create an exact copy of the chosen card in hand.

name: Unworthy
text: Give an enemy follower -4|-0 this round. If you have fewer mana gems than your opponent, kill it instead.
